title: Contracts deployed by a factory contract get no ACCOUNT CREATE state change

target.versions_affected: e967ce8b7362b79c277e700e789181d76fbb5967, 3e22515a, 18db88f4 and f0c00cf5 (executed; range not established)

severity_basis: ContractDeployProcessor (contract_deploy.go at 3e22515a) records nested deploys only when they appear in the authorization tree; a factory contract that deploys with its own address is authorised implicitly, so the deployed contract gets no deploy row, although wallet-backend's docs/architecture/state-changes.md promises one. Missing history, no wrong value.

entries.expected: contract_deployed for CBZKN44R… deployed by the factory CATF2IK7… (transaction e20eff37…)
entries.observed: Executed at e967ce8b and 3e22515a through the replay harness, both inputs: dropped · partial, no deploy row for CBZKN44R… and no participants CATF2IK7…, CBZKN44R….

evidence.pre_fix: make replay-full (the whole corpus against wallet-backend at the pinned current commit e967ce8b, inputs sep54-s3 and rpc): dropped · partial on cap-0085/instance-with-external-ref-executable.testnet-4372196 (testnet ledger 4372196, transaction e20eff37b29f0d334eeae53920fd0a111369bf5eff3964b7c1657566e5590546). Same at 3e22515a.
evidence.expected_basis: The ledger meta shows the contract instance created by the factory's call; wallet-backend's own documentation (docs/architecture/state-changes.md) states a deploy row for every contract deployment.

reproduction.method: Re-run at wallet-backend 3e22515a on both inputs in a separate run before filing; the deploy row is missing as recorded.

history.note: Seen in the wallet-backend replay of the whole corpus; confirmed at 3e22515a.
Filed by the maintainers of this kit as https://github.com/stellar/wallet-backend/issues/806.
